justification: The opening task is substantially delivered across all occupied floors: 111 doors and 202 windows are present, all are wall-hosted, every room has at least one door, and the opening check reports no shared-rule findings. Real rework remains because most windows are outward-opening casements with 0.59 m sills—including upper-storey residential rooms—without evidence of restrictors or guarding, and the combined accessible/public WC entrance swings inward rather than providing the safer outward or sliding operation.
evidence: Live measurements: storeys 1–4 contain 33/26/26/26 doors and 44/51/51/56 windows; all 313 openings have wall hosts, all 202 windows face outside and open toward "outside," and access reports 109 rooms, none without a door. Window measurements show 176 of 202 at a 0.59 m sill; the WC door serves “F01:senior-living:Public WC and accessible WC” and opens into that room, with a 1.029 m nominal width. The agent explicitly claimed: “Suites, lounges, dining rooms and studios have … windows at a 600 mm sill.”
strengths: Complete whole-building coverage was provided on all four occupied storeys rather than only at ground level.
The delivered counts agree with the agent’s account: 111 doors and 202 windows.
All measured doors and windows are hosted in walls; every door bottom is at its storey floor level.

The access check reports 109 rooms, with zero rooms lacking a door; ground-floor rooms are reachable and upper floors are only unverified because of the disclosed reserved-core starting-model limitation, which is not penalized here.
All 202 windows are exterior-facing casements that open outward; no interior-facing daylight windows were found.
Door dimensions are generous: measured nominal-width groups are approximately 1.03, 1.20, 1.84 and 1.94 m, with no undersized group found.
All eight lift landing openings are sliding and nominally 1.20 m wide; the inspected family is the “Lift Landing Door – Centre Opening” version 1.
Stair doors open into the stair, are nominally 1.029 m wide, and two inspected stair doors have a 60-minute fire rating.
Room doors generally open into their served rooms rather than obstructing the corridor; the electrical-room door is the identified outward-opening exception.
Plan captures of storeys 2–4 show consistent corridor-door and perimeter-window coverage throughout the long double-loaded floors.
weaknesses: A widespread low-sill condition remains: 176 windows have measured sills of about 0.59 m. For upper-storey senior residential suites, outward-opening casements at that height need documented restrictors, guarding, or an alternate safe window configuration; none was established.
The WC door opens into the combined “Public WC and accessible WC.” For an accessible WC, an outward-opening or sliding entrance is preferable so a fallen occupant cannot block rescue access.
Moving-leaf and sash sweep clearance was not established. The opening measurements explicitly state that no moving leaf or sash was swept, so this is not assessed rather than passed.

The agent’s quoted 0.91 m and 1.83 m door sizes appear to describe authored leaf/type dimensions, while the measurements show nominal wall-opening widths around 1.03 m and 1.94 m. This is a convention difference, not fabrication, but the final report should have identified the reference used.

spec_violations.constraint: Windows must have sill heights and operation suitable and safe for the rooms they serve.
spec_violations.what_happened: Most windows are outward-opening casements with approximately 0.59 m sills, including upper residential storeys, without verified restrictors or guarding.
spec_violations.evidence: Measured sill distribution: 176 windows at 0.59 m and 26 at 0.89 m; all 202 have operation casement and open outward.

spec_violations.constraint: Accessible toilet thresholds should use a suitable rescue-safe door operation.
spec_violations.what_happened: The combined public/accessible WC entrance swings inward into the WC room.
spec_violations.evidence: Measurements for the WC door: sides are Main corridor and “F01:senior-living:Public WC and accessible WC”; it opens into the WC room; its nominal width is 1.029 m.
